choppa-v1-description.Text:
A heavy Ork blade hammered together from scavenged metal. It is crude, badly balanced and remarkably effective when swung with sufficient enthusiasm.

• Levels: 1-15
• Damage: 9-15
• Armour penetration: 15%
• WAAAGH!

choppa-v1-flavor.Text: 'It chops. Dat makes it a choppa.'

choppa-v2-description.Text:
Someone has taken the unusual step of sharpening this Choppa. The irregular edge now catches armour, flesh and anything else unfortunate enough to stand nearby.

• Levels: 16-25
• Damage: 11-16
• Armour penetration: 15%
• WAAAGH!

choppa-v3-description.Text:
This scarred weapon has earned a reputation for leaving survivors in considerable discomfort. Orks consider this a sign of quality workmanship.

• Levels: 26-35
• Damage: 20-30
• Armour penetration: 20%
• WAAAGH!
• WAAAAAAAAAAGH!

choppa-v4-description.Text:
Layer upon layer of dried blood, crude repairs and replacement teeth record the Choppa's long service. Its owners stopped counting victories when they ran out of fingers.

• Levels: 36-43
• Damage: 24-36
• Armour penetration: 20%
• WAAAGH!
• WAAAAAAAAAAGH!

choppa-v5-description.Text:
A brutally oversized edge reinforced with whatever metal its owner could steal. Among Orks, calling a weapon 'dead killy' is both high praise and a warning to keep well clear of it.

• Levels: 44-49
• Damage: 30-46
• Armour penetration: 25%
• WAAAGH!
• SLAUGHTER

choppa-v6-description.Text:
Every Ork claims to own the biggest and best Choppa. The bearer of this weapon has settled the argument repeatedly and with considerable finality.

• Levels: 50-55
• Damage: 38-55
• Armour penetration: 30%
• WAAAGH!
• SLAUGHTER

choppa-v6-flavor.Text: 'Da best Choppa belongs to da Ork still standin'.'

choppa-waaagh-description.Text: Charge an enemy and strike with the equipped Choppa. Cost: 1 AP.

choppa-strike-description.Text: Make a single melee attack with the equipped Choppa. Cost: 1 AP.

choppa-greater-waaagh-description.Text: Release a deafening war cry. Enemies in the area must pass a Toughness resistance test or become stunned for 1 round. Cost: 1 AP. Usable once per combat.

choppa-v5-slaughter-description.Text: Strike all enemies around the target area for 150% weapon damage, then enter a slaughter-frenzy for 2 rounds. Cost: 2 AP. Usable once per combat.

choppa-v6-slaughter-description.Text: Strike all enemies around the target area for 150% weapon damage, then enter a slaughter-frenzy for 2 rounds. Cost: 2 AP. Usable once per combat.

choppa-slaughter-buff-description.Text: +20% damage and +10 Weapon Skill, but -20% parry and dodge chance for 2 rounds.

big-choppa-v1-description.Text:
A two-handed Ork blade assembled from enough scavenged metal to armour a small vehicle. Its owner chose instead to attach it all to one handle.

• Levels: 1-15
• Damage: 12-21
• Armour penetration: 25%
• BIG SWING!

big-choppa-v1-flavor.Text: 'If ya need two hands, it'z twice as choppy.'

big-choppa-v2-description.Text:
Someone has sharpened this already excessive weapon. The work is uneven, enthusiastic and capable of removing several important things at once.

• Levels: 16-25
• Damage: 15-26
• Armour penetration: 25%
• BIG SWING!

big-choppa-v2-flavor.Text: 'It got bigger. Dat means it got better.'

big-choppa-v3-description.Text:
Repeated impacts have bent the blade into a shape its maker insists was intentional. Orks judge the weapon by the size of the dents it leaves behind.

• Levels: 26-35
• Damage: 21-30
• Armour penetration: 30%
• BIG SWING!
• SPIN TA WIN!

big-choppa-v4-description.Text:
This Big Choppa has accumulated extra plates, teeth and weight with every repair. Subtlety was discarded early in the process to make room for more metal.

• Levels: 36-43
• Damage: 32-45
• Armour penetration: 30%
• BIG SWING!
• SPIN TA WIN!

big-choppa-v5-description.Text:
A dead killy monument to poor judgement, built too large for sensible warriors and therefore exactly large enough for an ambitious Ork.

• Levels: 44-49
• Damage: 37-56
• Armour penetration: 35%
• BIG SWING!
• DA BIGGEST BONK!

big-choppa-v6-description.Text:
The final answer to the ancient Ork question of how large a Choppa ought to be: larger than its wielder, louder than nearby gunfire and preferably still accelerating.

• Levels: 50-55
• Damage: 43-64
• Armour penetration: 40%
• BIG SWING!
• DA BIGGEST BONK!

big-choppa-v6-flavor.Text: 'Dis one ends arguments. An' floors Orks.'

big-choppa-big-swing-description.Text: Sweep a broad arc for 110% weapon damage and push every target back 1 cell. The wielder suffers -10% parry and dodge for 1 round. Cost: 2 AP.

big-choppa-spin-description.Text: Spin wildly, striking all nearby enemies for 100% weapon damage and pushing them back 1 cell. The wielder suffers -20 Weapon Skill and dodge for 1 round. Cost: 2 AP. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

big-choppa-bonk-description.Text: Make one spectacularly ill-advised attack for 300% weapon damage. This attack can critically hit. After the attack, the wielder is knocked prone for 1 round. Cost: 2 AP. Usable once per combat.

big-choppa-big-swing-buff-description.Text: -10% parry and dodge chance for 1 round.

big-choppa-spin-buff-description.Text: -20 Weapon Skill and dodge chance for 1 round.

big-choppa-cleave-description.Text: Swing the Big Choppa through the three tiles directly in front of the wielder. Cost: 2 AP.

power-klaw-v1-description.Text:
A roaring mechanical claw built from pistons, scavenged armour plate and the Ork conviction that anything worth grabbing is worth crushing.

• Test version V1
• Damage: 14-24
• Armour penetration: 30%
• Original human fist attack animations

power-klaw-v1-flavor.Text: 'Grab it. Squeeze it. If it stops movin', squeeze da next one.'
